label: GB-dpa-2018 Section 75

obligations.text:
(2)
The controller must inform the Commission about the categories of data transfers that take place in reliance on subsection (1A)(b) but not in reliance on section 73(4)(aa) (transfer to processor).

(3)
Where a transfer of data takes place in reliance on this section but not in reliance on section 73(4)(aa) (transfer to processor)—
(a)
the transfer must be documented,
(b)
the documentation must be provided to the Commission on request, and
(c)
the documentation must include, in particular—
(i)
the date and time of the transfer,
(ii)
the name of and any other pertinent information about the recipient,
(iii)
the justification for the transfer, and
(iv)
a description of the personal data transferred.
